name: fmt_duration
description:
Returns a human-readable representation of a duration given in nanoseconds.
For example, `1500000000` (1.5 billion nanoseconds) becomes `"1.5s"`.
Supported units: `nanos`, `micros`, `ms`, `s`, `m`, `h`, `d`. If a `unit` is provided,
the output is pinned to that unit instead of auto-scaling to the largest unit that fits.

params.name: nanoseconds
params.description: The duration in nanoseconds to format. If `null`, the function returns `null`.

params.name: unit
params.description: The unit to pin the output to: one of `nanos`, `micros`, `ms`, `s`, `m`, `h`, `d`. If omitted, the largest unit that keeps the value at least 1 is used.
